sections.indications_and_usage: Uses First aid to help prevent infection in minor cuts scrapes burns
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions: Clean the affected area Apply a small amount of this product (an amount equal to the surface area of the tip of a finger) on the area 1 to 3 times daily May be covered with a sterile bandage
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings For External use only. Do not use If you are allergic to any of the ingredients in the eyes over large areas of the body Ask a doctor before use if you have: deep puncture wounds animal bites serious burns
